title: Cop Takes Down Fleeing Motorcyclist After High Speed Pursuit
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Grand Blanc Township, Michigan — On August 17, 2025, at 8:10 p.m. Grand Blanc Township Officers attempted to stop a motorcyclist for speeding, but instead found themselves chasing him at over 100 miles per hour through multiple jurisdictions before he eventually crashed near a Flint parking lot. Investigators say the 37-year-old Fenton man tried to escape on foot, discarding methamphetamine and a handgun as he ran, but was quickly caught. Grand Blanc Township police sought the following charges: second offense of possession of controlled substances, third degree fleeing a police officer, resisting/obstructing a police officer, carrying a concealed weapon and six other weapons charges.
